name: safe_edit_file
description: Replace a string inside a file under AGENT_OS_ROOT. Creates a timestamped .bak.<ts>, then validates the file (Python compile / JSON parse / YAML load). On validation failure the original is restored automatically.
use_cases: patching agent_core.py to add a new policy rule
updating team_config.json to register a new model key
tweaking a SKILL.md after the model proposes an improvement

path.description: relative or absolute path inside AGENT_OS_ROOT

old.description: exact text to replace; empty string means full overwrite

name: apply_patch
description: Apply a unified diff to a single file. Uses GNU patch under the hood, makes a .bak first, validates the result, and rolls back on failure.
use_cases: applying a multi-hunk fix to agent_loop.py
patching system_awareness.py from a generated diff

unified_diff.description: diff text starting with --- a/... +++ b/...

name: rollback_file
description: Restore the most recent .bak.<ts> for a given file.
use_cases: undo the last self-edit when a regression is detected
Restore the most recent .bak.<ts> for a given file
